verdicts.reason: A breaks up the stripe motif: the grey and blue stripes float as unrelated bars, and the stripes stop at about y=380, leaving a dead white band along the bottom. The white card merges with the white background, so it no longer reads as a panel. It also cuts an odd notch into the red stripe, and 'TRAVEL MUGS' is jammed against the bottom edge where the stripes end, so the layout looks broken. B keeps the original stripes and card intact, so the brand survives, but it is just a shrunk copy centred in the banner with large empty white areas on both sides. Its body text and list are tiny, and it has not been rearranged for the wide format.
